# codeguyakash — Akash | Full-Stack Developer

> Personal website of Akash (@codeguyakash), a Full-Stack Developer based in Delhi, India.
> Specializes in React, Node.js, MERN Stack, and Chrome Extension development.
> Creator of "My Dark Theme" and "Secure Pass" Chrome extensions.

## About

Akash (username: codeguyakash) is a self-taught full-stack developer who has been building
web applications since 2020. He is passionate about React, open-source, and clean interfaces.
He is based in Delhi, India and is open to full-time opportunities.

## Chrome Extensions

- **My Dark Theme** — A minimal dark theme for Chrome.
  Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/my-dark-theme/chejinoklfdlokcdipnnccafebjekfdh

- **Secure Pass** — Strong password generator with right-click autofill.
  Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/secure-pass/ngfjlnlliapgjpcldjgblbmakhijgnhi

## Android Apps

- **AutoAssist** — Smart missed call manager that automatically replies to calls via SMS when busy, driving, or in a pocket. Evaluates sensors locally for dynamic templates.
  Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.codeguyakash.assist

- **Dev Launcher** — Clean, distraction-free home launcher built for developers and productivity. Zero permissions, R8-optimized, monochrome icons.
  Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.codeguyakash.launcher
